title: Scenario Augmentation for Rare Financial Events via Multimodal Latent Diffusion
abstract: arXiv:2611.07282v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Extreme market movements are scarce, heterogeneous, and difficult to learn from imbalanced historical data. We study whether generative augmentation can improve the representation and classification of CVaR-labeled rare financial windows while retaining the complementary structure exposed by different financial representations. Each market window is expressed through three aligned modalities: structured market variables, a spatial image transformation, and a sequence of portfolio returns. Separate variational autoencoders map the modalities to compact latent codes, and a class-conditional diffusion model learns their joint latent distribution. Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR) provides a risk-aware definition of rare windows and directs generation toward the minority regime. Across four window lengths on U.S. technology equities, the resulting synthetic samples improve fidelity and support relative to tabular diffusion baselines. An XGBoo

translated_title: 基于多模态潜在扩散的稀有金融事件情景增强
translated_abstract: 极端市场行情稀缺、异质性强，且难以从不平衡的历史数据中学习。我们研究生成式增强能否改善以条件风险价值（CVaR）标注的稀有金融窗口的表示与分类，同时保留不同金融表示方式所揭示的互补结构。每个市场窗口通过三种对齐的模态来表达：结构化市场变量、空间图像变换以及投资组合收益序列。各自独立的变分自编码器将这些模态映射为紧凑的潜在编码，并由一个类别条件扩散模型学习它们的联合潜在分布。条件风险价值（CVaR）为稀有窗口提供了风险感知的定义，并引导生成过程朝向少数类（尾部风险）状态。在美国科技股的四种窗口长度上，所生成的合成样本相较于表格扩散基线在保真度和样本支持度方面均有所提升。XGBoo...
tldr: 该论文提出一种多模态潜在扩散框架，以条件风险价值（CVaR）定义稀有金融窗口，通过类别条件扩散模型在三种对齐模态的联合潜在空间中生成尾部风险情景，从而提升稀有金融事件的表示质量与分类性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a multimodal latent diffusion framework that defines rare financial windows via CVaR and generates tail-risk scenarios with a class-conditional diffusion model over a joint latent space of three aligned modalities, improving representation and classification of rare financial events.
